hypothesis: A 24-thread CTA may balance the lower lane utilization and scheduling cost of very small blocks against the extra parallel CTAs available relative to the 256-thread baseline. The workload may improve or regress; only controller measurements can determine the effect.
notes: Changes launch geometry only; the kernel mapping, force equations, and memory strategy remain unchanged. The proposal has not been validated or timed. Validate every supported size before comparing official timings.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 24, retaining shared_memory_bytes at zero.
